checked.CE0_old_arithmetic: Modality CE; per-field start/end unreduced ignored-absent CEs averaged by .5; optional presence CE added before mean; equal sum with modality divided by seven. Weight exactly zero returns that same ce object directly, skips float64 structure and preserves old scalar arithmetic.
checked.backend_ownership: The module imports math only. No model open, forward, optimizer, backward, network or internal fit admission is present. The caller supplies the backend and owns fit/admission lineage.
checked.conditional_distribution_normalization: Both scalar and backend versions normalize valid intervals before adding a large absolute shift back. Starts/ends are marginal sums of the normalized valid-pair distribution; normalization is checked with 1e-9 tolerance.
checked.exact_normalized_pair_overlap: For inclusive valid intervals, P(overlap)=1-P(E_left<S_right)-P(E_right<S_left). Prefix sums exclude ends equal to a start. Disjoint directional events are mutually exclusive under valid intervals, so the CDF identity is exact for independently drawn field intervals.
checked.field_and_row_averaging: Validity averages active reference fields per row; overlap averages all unordered active reference-field pairs per row; these averages are then averaged over rows and combined with equal one-half weighting.
checked.finite_forward_and_bounds: Closed CPU float32 output shape and finite values are required. Log mass, normalized marginals, pair probabilities and all loss scalars are checked; structure uses float64 and pair/validity values clamp only within a checked rounding allowance.
checked.inert_test_quality: Hand-derived uniform mass and 7/9 overlap; exhaustive independent interval-pair overlap enumeration; present/absent gating; stable underflow/extreme scalar cases; token/label/latent schema refusal; numerical-import denial and no-forward AST checks.
checked.padded_logits: Structured log_softmax crops each row to its actual token count before valid-pair construction. CE intentionally retains old finite-padding arithmetic over full padded width.
checked.reference_presence_gating: Actor/action are required true. Optional fields are selected from supplied reference Boolean labels, never predicted presence logits; absent heads cannot lower structured loss by predicting absence.
checked.stable_valid_order_mass: Actual-row float32 pointers are converted to float64; log_softmax precedes masked valid triangular log pairs. Max over valid entries is removed before logsumexp and normalization. Invalid entries stay -infinity, so tiny valid mass can underflow in diagnostics without taking log(0) in the loss.

limitations: No numerical objective, Torch gradient or exact CE-parity execution was performed by this reviewer.
Internal record geometry has no complete source bytes, source provenance, reviewer identity or semantic target authority; supplied label geometry is not independently authenticated.
The scalar oracle and static algebra support forward probability arithmetic only; finite gradient and optimizer behavior need the root-owned admitted probe.
root_numerical_probe_requirements: On identical saved outputs and labels, compare old-owner CE and structure_weight=0 ce/total by exact torch equality, then compare all parameter/input gradients and verify total aliases ce.
Compare Torch float64 structure diagnostics to the independent scalar oracle and brute-force interval-pair values for asymmetric nonuniform synthetic pointers.

Use mixed actual token lengths; change only cropped padding to large finite values and prove structured components/gradients stay unchanged while reporting any intentional full-width CE change separately.

Backpropagate an invalid-order synthetic row with extremely small valid mass and equal extreme valid-pair scores; verify finite loss/gradients, normalized pair probabilities and absent-head structured gradients zero.
Verify reference optional presence stays fixed when predicted presence logits change; structured values must remain unchanged.

Probe the supported numerical domain separately from CE overflow: finite float32 logits near +/-3e38 can still make legacy float32 CE overflow, which should be refused as nonfinite CE rather than claimed universally trainable.
